landing.heading: Your footage, cut and ready to post.
landing.sub: Sample 3 Studio takes the videos already on your phone and turns them into short posts. You read every one before it goes anywhere.

steps.title: Dump it
steps.body: Send the clips off your phone. No folders, no naming, no editing app.

steps.title: We cut it
steps.body: The studio cuts short posts from your footage, writes the captions and lines them up.

steps.title: You approve
steps.body: Nothing posts until you tap approve. Ten posts a week per channel, at most.

facts: Sign in with a code we email you. No password.
